_README: Rutgers Core as Rutgers Business School-New Brunswick states it in the 2026-2027 catalog, composed with every RBS-NB program (Prompt 08 B1).

The catalog gives the STRUCTURE (two Contemporary Challenges courses, six Areas of Inquiry courses, five Cognitive Skills and Processes courses; at least 3 credits each; degree credit; no Pass/No Credit) and defers the course lists: 'Students should see Degree Navigator for specific courses and conditions.'

So the eligible-course lists are UNKNOWN here (course_list_unknown). They are not borrowed from SAS or SEBS: the RBS page does not state which goal codes fill which category. Plans show these requirements as open with that reason.
